verses.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.sm: Iesu ) Ua latalata le tausamiga o areto e le faafefeteina, e ta‘ua o le paseka.

verses.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.sm: Ona saili lea e le au ositaulaga sili ma le au tusiupu, pe faapefea ona latou fasioti ia te ia; aua ua latou matatau i le nuu.

verses.en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.sm: Ona uluitino ai lea o Satani ia Tuta e taʻua o le Sekara, o le tasi lea o le toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.sm: Ua alu ia, ua tautalatala ma le au ositaulaga sili ma ta‘ita‘i o ‘au,

verses.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.sm: i se togafiti na te faalataina ai o ia ia te latou tautalatala ma ia e avatu ai tupe.

verses.en: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.sm: Ua lelei ia te ia, ona lamalama lea o ia se itu aso e faigofie ai, na te faalataina ai o ia ia te i latou, a o le i ai le motu o tagata.

verses.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le aso o areto e le faafefeteina, e tatau ona fasi ai o le paseka.

verses.en: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu lea e ia o Peteru ma Ioane, ua faapea atu, “Lua te o e sauni le paseka mo i tatou, tatou te aai ai.”

verses.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.sm: Ona la fai mai ai lea ia te ia, “O ifea e te finagalo i ai ma te saunia?”

verses.en: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i laua, “Faauta, a oo oulua i totonu o le aai, tou te fetaiaʻi ma le tagata o ave le vai omea, lua te mulimuli atu ia te ia i le fale e ulu atu iai o ia.

verses.en: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.sm: Lua te fai atu i le matai o le aiga, Ua fai mai le aʻoaʻo ia te oe, Po o ifea le afeafe e api ai malo, ina ia matou aai ai le paseka, o aʻu ma oʻu soo?

verses.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.sm: Ona faasino atu ai lea e ia ia te oulua o le afeafe tele aupitoaluga ua uma ona teu; lua te sauni ai le paseka.”

verses.en: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.sm: Ona la o ai lea, ua iloa ai pei ona fetalai atu o ia ia te i laua; ona la sauni ai lea o le paseka.

verses.en: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le itu aso, ona taoto ai lea o ia e taumafa, sa faatasi ma ia le au aposetolo e toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, “Ua tele lava loʻu manao e muai ‘ai lenei paseka ma outou, a o lei oo i loʻu tiga.

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Aua ou te fai atu ia te outou, ou te le toe ‘ai ai lava, seia oo ina faaiuina i le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea o ia i le ipu, ua faafetai, ua IZI fetalai atu, “Ta outou tago i lenei ipu, ma ia tufatufa ane ia te outou;

verses.en: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.sm: aua ou te fai atu ia te outou, E amata atu nei, ou te le inu lava i le fua o le vine, seia oo mai le malo o le Atua.”

verses.en: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea o ia i le areto, ua faafetai, ua tofitofi, ma avatu ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “O loʻu tino lenei, lua foaiina atu mo outou; tou te faia le mea nei e fai ma faamanatuga ia te au.”

verses.en: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.sm: Sa faapea foi ona tago i le ipu, ina ua uma ona talisua, ua faapea atu, “O lenei ipu o le feagaiga fou lea i loʻu toto, ua faamaligiina mo outou.

verses.en: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
verses.sm: A e peitai, faauta mai, o ia te au i le laulau nei le lima o 18 faalata ia te au.

verses.en: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.sm: Aua e alu lava le Atalii o le tagata e pei ona tofia; a o lea tagata na te faalataina o ia, oi talofa ia te ia!”

verses.en: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.sm: Ona latou fesueai ai lea, po o ai so latou o le a na faia lea mea.

verses.en: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.sm: Sa latcu fefinauai foi po o ai so latou e sili.

verses.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou, “O tupu o nuu ese ua aliitai i latou; o e pule foi ia i latou ua taʻua i latou o e agalelei.

verses.en: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.sm: A e le faapea outou; peitai o le sili ia te outou, ia avea o ia ia pei o le aupito itiiti; o le pule foi, ia pei o le auauna ia.

verses.en: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.sm: Aua po o ai le sili; o le taoto ea c ʻai, po o le auauna mai? E le o le taoto e “ai ea? A o aʻu nei, o loo ia te outou pei o le auauna lava.

verses.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.sm: “O outou foi, ua outou tumau ia te au i oʻu tofotofoga.

verses.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.sm: E faapei ona tofia mai e loʻu Tama o le malo ia te au, e faapea foi ona ou tofia outou,

verses.en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.sm: ina ia outou aai ma inu i laʻu laoai i loʻu malo, ma ia nonofo i nofoalii, ma faamasino atu i itu aiga o Isaraelu e sefulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
verses.sm: “Simona e, Simona e, faauta, ua manao tele Satani ia te outou, ia lulu ia te outou pei o le saito;

verses.en: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.sm: a ua ou faatoga mo oe, ina neʻi mavae lou faatuatua; a o oe foi, pe a liua mai oe, ona e faamalosi ai lea i ou uso.”

verses.en: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai o ia ia te ia, “Le ALII e, ua ou sauni ta te o faatasi ma ce i le fale puipui atoa ma le oti.”

verses.en: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia, “Peteru e, ou te fai atu ia te oe, e le vivini moa i le po nei, seia e faafiti faatolu mai e te le iloa au.”

verses.en: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou, “Ina ua ou aauina atu outou e leai sa outou ete tupe, po o se ‘ato, po o seevae, pe na outou matitiva ea i se mea e tasi?” Ua fai mai i latou, “E leai lava.”

verses.en: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu ai lea o ia ia re i latou, “A o lenei, ai se tagata e ana se ete tupe, ina tago ia i ai, e faapea foi sana “ato; o le tagata foi e leai sana pelu, ia avatu lona ofu e faatau ak mai.

verses.en: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.sm: Aua ou te fai atu ia te outou, e tatau ona taunuu mai ia te au o le mea ua tusia, o lea, Na faitauina foio ia faatasi ma e pagotata; aua foi o le a faaiuina mea ua tusia ia te au.”

verses.en: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.sm: Ua latou fai mai, “Le ALII e, faauta, o pelu nei e lua.” Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Soia.”

verses.en: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.sm: Ua maliu atu o ia i fafo, ua savali atu i le mauga o Olive, ua faapea lana masani; ua mulimuli atu foi ona soo ia te ia.

verses.en: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu o ia i lea mea, ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Ta outou tatalo ne'i oo mai le faaosoosoga ia te outou.”

verses.en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.sm: Ona maliu ese lea o ia ia te i latou, e pei o le togi o le maa ona mamao, ona tootuli ai lea o ia ua tatalo,

verses.en: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.sm: “Lo'u Tama e, a e finagalo i ai, ia e ave ese lenei ipu ia te au; a e aua le faia lo'u loto, a o lou finagalo.”

verses.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.sm: Ona faaali mai ai lea ia te ia o le agelu mai le lagi, ua faamalosi ia te ia.

verses.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.sm: Ua puapuaga o ia, ua atili ai lana tatalo; o lona afu foi ua pei o ‘alu‘alu toto ua pau ifo i le eleele.

verses.en: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.sm: Ua tulai o ia sa tatalo, ona maliu atu lea i ona soo, ua maua i latou ua momoe ina ua tiga i le alofa.

verses.en: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Se a le mea tou te momoe ai? Ina tulai ia, ina tatalo, neʻi oo mai le faaosoosoga ia te outou.”

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.sm: O loo fetalai o ia, faauta, O le motu o tagata, ma lè ua igoa la Iuta, o le tasi o le toasefulu ma le toalua, ua muamua mai o ia ia te i latou, ma s6s6 mai ia Iesu e sogi ia te ia.

verses.en: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te ia, “Iuta e, e te faalataina ea le Atalii o le tagata ma le sogi?”

verses.en: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.sm: Ua iloa e i latou ua faatasi ma ia o le mea o le a fai, ona latou fai mai ai lea ia te ia, “Le ALII e, pe matou te taia ea i le pelu?”

verses.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.sm: so O le tasi tagata o i latou, ua ta e ia le auauna a le ositaulaga sili, ua tipiesea lona taliga taumatau.

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu, ua faapea atu, ‘Soia, ua lava lea.” Ona tapo ai lea o ia i lona taliga, ua faamalolo ia te ia.

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu i le au ositaulaga sili, ma ta‘nai o ‘au o le malumalu, ma toeaina, e na o mai ia te ia, “Ua outou o mai ma pelu ma uatogi, peiseai O se puega o se fao mea?

verses.en: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.sm: Sa tatou i le malumalu ma outou i aso fai soo, e lei oo mai lava o outou lima ia te au; a o lo outou itu po lenei, ma le pule a le pouliuli.”

verses.en: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.sm: Ona latou pue lea ja te ia, ua ta'ita'i ma ave ia te ia i le fale o le ositaulaga sili. A ua mulimuli mamao atu Peteru.

verses.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.sm: Ua latou tafu le afi i totonu o le maota, ua latou nonofo i lalo, ua nofo foi Peteru faatasi ma i latou.

verses.en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.sm: A ua iloa atu o ia e le tasi auauna teine o nofo mai i tafatafa o le afi, ona pulatoa lea ia te ia, ua faapea ane, “O lenei tagata foi sa faatasi ma ia.”

verses.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.sm: A ua faafiti atu o ia ia te ia, ua faapea atu, “Funa e, ou te le iloa o ia.”

verses.en: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.sm: Ua toe itiiti, ona vaai mai lea o le tasi ia te ia, ua faapea mai, “O oe foi le tasi o i latou.” Ona fai atu lea o Peteru, “Sole, e le o aʻu.”

verses.en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.sm: Ua mavae, pe atoa le itu po e tasi, ona matua fai mai ai lea o le tasi, “E moni lava, sa ia te ia lenei tagata; aua o le Kalilaia foi o ia.”

verses.en: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Peteru, “Sole, ou te le iloa le mea e te fai mai na.” Ona vivini loa lea o toa, a o tautala o ia.

verses.en: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.sm: Ona faliu lea o le ALII, ua silasila atu ia Peteru, Ona manatu mai ai lea o Peteru i le fetalaiga a le ALII, na ia fetalai mai ia te la, “E le vivini moa seia e laafiti faatolu mai ia te au.”

verses.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o ia i fafo, ua tagi lotulotu 1a.

verses.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
verses.sm: O tagata ua taofi ia Iesu, ua latou tauemu ma sasa ia te ia.

verses.en: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.sm: Ua latou ufiufi ona fofoga, ona po mai ai Ica i ona fofoga, ua fesili mai foi ia te ia, “E te iite mai, po o ai na na po atu ia te ce?”

verses.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.sm: O isi foi upu e tele ua latou upu leaga ai ia te ia.

verses.en: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.sm: Ua a0, ona faapotopoto ai lea o le taupulega o le nuu, o le au ositaulaga sili, ma le au tusiupu, ona ta°ita‘i atu lea ia te ia i la latou fono, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.sm: “Afai o oe o le Keriso, fai mai ia ia te i matou.” Ona fe:alai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Pe aѓai ou te fai atu ia te outou, tou te le talitonu mai lava;

verses.en: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
verses.sm: afai foi ou te fesili ia te outou, tou te le tali mai lava.

verses.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.sm: E amata atu nei ona nofo o le Atalii o le tagata i le itu taumatau o le Atua mamana.”

verses.en: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o i latou uma, “O oe foi ea le Alo o le Atua?” Ua fetalai atu o ia ia te i latou,

verses.en: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.sm: “O aʻu lea ua outou fai mai ai na.” Ona latou fai ane ai lea, “Se a le aoga O sa tatou toe molimau?
